name: Cube CLI
description: Remote control for the CubeSandbox control plane: sandbox lifecycle, ports and files.
whenToUse: Create, list, inspect, pause, resume, snapshot, clone or delete a CubeSandbox, or debug control-plane connectivity.

cube_version.description: Show Cube CLI version and platform; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

cube_health.description: Check CubeSandbox control-plane health; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

cube_run.description: Run any Cube CLI subcommand (new, ls, rm, exec, code, info, ports...); returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

/properties/cmd.description: Subcommand name, e.g. new, ls, rm, exec, code, info.

/properties/args.description: Arguments for the subcommand, e.g. ["--need=code"] or ["sid", "uname -a"].

cube_submit.description: Submit a long-running task asynchronously and return immediately; returns { taskId, cmd, status, message }.

cube_log.description: Read logs of a task submitted by cube_submit; returns { taskId, status, completed, exitCode, logs, nextOffset, totalLines }.

/properties/offset.description: Line index to start reading from; defaults to the beginning.

cube_kill.description: Terminate a running background task; returns { taskId, killed }.
